prayers.name: Blood Boil
prayers.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Uncontrollable Rage
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of 'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Final Act of Violence
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll as 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
